source_snapshot.procedure: Use BMC WebUI, check readable Network Protocol text, enable and populate IPv4 and IPv6 DNS, apply, then wait three to five minutes.
source_snapshot.criteria: Correct DNS display and readable text in all supported browsers.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; sets only IPv4 public DNS with assumed IPMI syntax and exposed credentials.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION for dual-stack values, browser matrix, visual evidence and rollback.

old_problem: This already had a coherent conditional review, but remained Pending solely because project resolver values, browser versions and safe restore data were not populated.
disposition_reason: The functional action and oracle are explicit: save IPv4 and IPv6 DNS settings, wait the stated interval, and verify correct readable presentation in every supported browser. Exact resolver addresses and the finite browser list are Project Configuration Requirements under ED-36, not new engineering semantics.
decision_basis: Direct inspection covered XLSX row 828, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record.
The preserved source consistently requires both address families, apply/wait and browser visual acceptance; existing source_conflict and blocked analyses are false.
A filtered IPv4 IPMI output cannot prove IPv6 fields or rendered text, and an unapproved public resolver must not be introduced into a management network.
ED-31 keeps visual readability human-owned, while dual-stack readback and controlled resolver checks remain substantive assisted evidence.

test_case.test_name: Configure and visually verify BMC IPv4/IPv6 DNS in every supported browser
test_case.purpose: Verify that the actual BMC WebUI accepts, saves and correctly renders approved IPv4 and IPv6 DNS settings, with readable labels and values across the complete Project-supported browser matrix after the source-required stabilization period, then restores the prior state.
required_package: BMC firmware and authoritative DNS field/apply behavior
Approved reachable IPv4 and IPv6 resolver addresses plus any domain/search values and optional project-owned query names
Supported browser names/versions, client OS, locale, zoom/DPI and viewport matrix
Saved prior DNS state, literal-IP/local recovery, protected credentials and restore order
test_case.test_command: Record current DNS/network state. For each supported browser/version, operator opens the actual Network Protocol page and captures baseline readability. Using the approved UI flow, enable DNS, enter the same approved IPv4 and IPv6 resolver matrix, save/apply, wait three to five minutes, reload or start a new session, and verify exact persisted values and readable text. Protected API/IPMI readback and bounded queries to project-owned names may corroborate persistence/function. Restore the original values after the final browser and confirm access.
test_case.expected_result: Every selected browser renders all DNS labels/controls without truncation, corruption or misleading text and displays the exact normalized IPv4/IPv6 values after apply, three-to-five-minute wait and reload. Authoritative readback matches. If functional queries are part of Project SPEC, both approved resolver paths return the expected records. Restore returns the exact baseline without BMC management disruption.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both address families and every Project-supported browser; one browser, IPv4-only output or a DNS query alone is insufficient. FAIL includes unreadable/malformed UI, missing address family, value/persistence mismatch, unapproved resolver use, management impact or restore failure. Missing resolver or browser list makes execution NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Never substitute 8.8.8.8 or another public/guessed resolver without network-policy approval
Preserve literal-IP/local access and exact prior values before the write
Protect credentials; do not assume channel, cipher or unsupported `ipmitool dns1` semantics
Do not collapse IPv4 and IPv6 or reuse one-browser visual evidence
Stop on reachability loss, malformed value, service impact or restore failure; no automatic save retry
expected_evidence: BMC/firmware/interface identity, prior state and approved resolver plan
Per-browser before/after screenshots with exact dual-stack values and readable labels
Apply/wait/reload timestamps and protected authoritative readback
Optional separately labelled project-name query results
Exact restore diff and final address/name-based access plus logs
test_case.recovery: Use saved literal-IP/local access to restore the exact prior DNS values through the approved interface, wait for apply, then verify both management access and displayed/readback state. Preserve first-failure browser/configuration evidence and do not retry the save automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and Criteria consistently require dual-stack DNS configuration and cross-browser presentation.

blocked.reason: Resolver values, browser matrix and restore data are ordinary readiness inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: IPv4/IPv6 resolvers, browser/OS/locale/viewport list, exact fields, optional query names and restore package.

external_authorities.title: RFC 1035 — Domain Names Implementation and Specification
external_authorities.use: Provides standard DNS query/response behavior; BMC field layout and browser support remain platform/project-specific.
